name: Kjeldor
description: Nation on Dominaria whose army Varchild led.

timeline.summary: Taaveti praises the Kjeldorans as allies.
timeline.quote: "I have been a warrior for over four hundred years, and yet each generation of Kjeldorans teaches me new tricks. There can be no better allies."

citation.text: Formation (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zur the Enchanter declares he and his followers are Kjeldorans no more.
timeline.quote: "We are Kjeldorans no more."

citation.text: Zuran Enchanter (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn says Freyalise cleansed the druids' bodies and gave them Fyndhorn.
timeline.quote: "Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor;

citation.text: Essence Filter (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Darien takes the throne of Kjeldor on his mother's death in 2933 AR.
timeline.quote: Darien ascended to the throne upon the death of his mother in 2933 AR

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darien consolidates his power, forms a single army under General Varchild, and allies with the Balduvians against Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: This allowed him to make an alliance with the Balduvians and lead an army against Lim-Dûl

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Twenty years into the Thaw, Darien and Lovisa merge their nations into New Argive and fight the Battle of Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: planned for their two nations to be merged into New Argive

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darien duels Haakon from dusk till dawn; his men rush Haakon, who is overwhelmed and killed, ending the battle.
timeline.quote: Darien fought a duel against the zombie leader Haakon that lasted from dusk till dawn

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darien sends Sir Zaraya and the finest knights to Balduvia in answer to a nomad plea.
timeline.quote: He summons Sir Zaraya and orders her to collect the finest Knights of Kjeldor and to travel to Balduvia .

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise, disguised, convinces Zaraya to hand over the Nova Pentacle and prophesizes Jaeuhl as champion.
timeline.quote: Prophesizing that Jaeuhl will be the champion in the final battle

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise charges Jaeuhl to defeat Szat and arms him.
timeline.quote: She asks Jaeul to slay the demon or to banish him from Dominaria.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor is founded by Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald, who leave Storgard before the ice covers it.
timeline.quote: Kjeldor was founded around 2434 AR by Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor trades with Fyndhorn, and elves teach its healers in exchange for keeping orcs at bay.
timeline.quote: The elves taught Kjeldor's healers in exchange for keeping the neighboring orcs at bay.

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The capital is moved from Kjeld to Krov, where the Royal Academy of Magic is established.
timeline.quote: At some point, the capital was moved from Kjeld to Krov

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: By 2934 Kjeldor is weak and decentralized, with factions of wizards and the military split.
timeline.quote: By 2934, Kjeldor was weak and decentralized.

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avram Garrison, aided by Lim-Dul, forms the Knights of Stromgald and attempts a coup, which fails; the Knights become zombified minions.
timeline.quote: The coup failed, and the Knights were turned into zombified minions of Lim-Dûl

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darien takes firm control, unites the army under General Varchild and allies with the Balduvian barbarians against Lim-Dul.
timeline.quote: even made an alliance with the Balduvian barbarians

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the final battle against Lim-Dul, the alliance shatters and Varchild goes rogue against the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: After the final battle against Lim-Dûl, the alliance shattered

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah convinces Darien and Lovisa Coldeyes to stop fighting and cooperate, leading to the merger into New Argive.
timeline.quote: This cooperation would eventually result in the merger of the two countries into New Argive

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl flees from a battle with goblins and, caught in a blizzard, finds the ring of Mairsil among the remains of the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl fled while the others were slaughtered.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah escapes with Jaya Ballard and they seek to unite Kjeldor with the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: Jodah escaped with the aid of his old friend Jaya Ballard

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl poisons the Knights of Stromgald when they plot a coup, zombifying them; Jodah saves King Darien and Kjeldor allies with the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: allowed Darien to unite them and forge an alliance with the Balduvians

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl's armies burn the village of Breway.
timeline.quote: Breway - a small village, put to the torch by Lim-Dûl 's armies

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avram Garrisson demands Kjeldor be supreme at any cost.
timeline.quote: "Kjeldor must be supreme at any cost."

citation.text: Stromgald Cabal (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Varchild and Darien exchange missives over the carrier pigeons.
timeline.quote: "Birds know no borders! Why, then, should we?"

citation.text: Carrier Pigeons (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: King Darien calls every able sword to Kjeldor's side.
timeline.quote: "Call every able sword to our side. Kjeldor will stand triumphant!"

citation.text: Errand of Duty (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes says Balduvia willingly trades with Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: "We willingly trade with Kjeldor, but the peace we build must come from both our lands."

citation.text: Kjeldoran Escort (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Halvor Arensson laments that nothing grows in Kjeldor but seaweed.
timeline.quote: "It's not so easy anymore. Nothing grows in Kjeldor but seaweed."

citation.text: Royal Herbalist (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Varchild calls for Balduvia to burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth.
timeline.quote: "Let Balduvia burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth!"

citation.text: Omen of Fire (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl speaks of the Kjeldoran Dead killing those they loved.
timeline.quote: They shall kill those whom once they loved."

citation.text: Kjeldoran Dead (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The alliance of Balduvia and Kjeldor forces Stromgald agents to fuel rituals with their own flesh.
timeline.quote: When the alliance between Balduvia and Kjeldor deprived Stromgald of easy victories, its agents were forced to fuel their rituals with their own flesh.

citation.text: Stromgald Cabal (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Avram Garrisson proclaims Kjeldoran supremacy.
timeline.quote: "Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!"

citation.text: Knight of Stromgald (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Scribe Barrinalo records Pharon's dying words, leaves Kjeld and adopts the name Barrin when ink runs while signing out.
timeline.quote: he adopted the name "Barrin" in recognition of his new life

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Barrinalo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The alliance of Balduvia and Kjeldor deprives Stromgald of victories so its agents fuel rituals with their own flesh.
timeline.quote: its agents were forced to fuel their rituals with their own flesh.

citation.text: Stromgald Cabal (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Knights of Stromgald strike Darien's Roost from two sides; Darien's tacticians prevent a pincer attack on Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: The Knights of Stromgald struck Darien's Roost from two sides.

citation.text: Field Marshal (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Darien fulfills his dream of unification and becomes the last king of Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor.

citation.text: Darien, King of Kjeldor (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yavimayan shamans destroy the Phyrexians; Kjeldor and Yavimaya rout the cultists and a ritual ends the unnatural winter, restoring the Thaw.
timeline.quote: a Yavimayan ritual permanently ended Rimewind's unnatural winter and restored the Thaw to its proper course

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The End of Rimewind". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes says the villages of Kjeldor burn in retaliation.
timeline.quote: "The embers of our homes still smolder, and already the villages of Kjeldor burn in retaliation."

citation.text: Pillage (Masters 25, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The first Stromgald attack comes after three days of waiting; the defenders cut down the vanguard and hold the line, though some enemies get back up.
timeline.quote: Our line held, however, and when the first wave reached us, they were stopped cold.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The first day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The second night's two-part attack, with knights breaking through, is slowed by the defenders' placement and closed in on by reinforcements.
timeline.quote: As the knights broke through, we closed ranks behind them.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The second day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The narrator deploys the Jotun squad of giants who had seen what Stromgald does to a land.
timeline.quote: It was at this time that I decided to deploy our Jötun squad .

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The second day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the third night the dead from both sides keep rising and fighting; a fallen Jotun is seen again as a Stromgald zombie, and the defenders grow stronger, ending with less than half their numbers.
timeline.quote: By the time the fighting was finally over, we had less than half of our original numbers.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The third day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the fourth night only Haakon comes forward; Darien goes out to face him and the two leaders fight for hours.
timeline.quote: The two leaders of the armies fought for hours.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The fourth day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The defenders realize the Stromgald army is watching from beyond and, understanding Darien would die for them, swarm out and charge.
timeline.quote: As one, we swarmed out of our emplacements and charged.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The fourth day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slowed by the soldiers' waves, Haakon is finished off by Darien, and his army slinks away; Kjeldor wins.
timeline.quote: Darien, who looked a lot more bloodied up close, was able to finish him off.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The fourth day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the defenders regroup, the narrator sees black smoke on the horizon and hears a faint alien sound.
timeline.quote: I saw lines of thick black smoke rising into the dawn sky.

citation.text: "The Battle of Kjeldor", section "The end". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The nation of New Argive is formed by Balduvia and Kjeldor after the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: The nation of New Argive was formed in 2954 AR by Balduvia and Kjeldor after the end of Dominaria's Ice Age

citation.text: "New Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arcum devotes his life to atonement, helps stop the Ice Phyrexians, warns Kjeldor, and dies of a heart attack.
timeline.quote: He died of a heart attack not long after.

citation.text: "Arcum Dagsson", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor is founded in the area of the old Argive around 2400 AR.
timeline.quote: the nation of Kjeldor would be founded in the same area that Argive had been

citation.text: "Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garrisson allies with Lim-Dul to overthrow Darien and forms the Order of Stromgald.
timeline.quote: working with the necromancer to overthrow Darien.

citation.text: "Avram Garrisson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya thwart the plan; Garrisson and followers flee to Lim-Dul, are killed and added to his zombie army.
timeline.quote: they were killed and added to the necromancer 's zombie army.

citation.text: "Avram Garrisson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Lim-Dul's Battle Garrisson goads Gustha into expending her spells, leading to her death.
timeline.quote: leading to her death.

citation.text: "Avram Garrisson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garrisson duels Varchild but is interrupted by an eruption; he is killed and his body burned.
timeline.quote: The undead Garrisson was killed in this battle, and his body was burned on a pyre.

citation.text: "Avram Garrisson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 2500 AR Balduvia declares war on Kjeldor over ancestral lands, beginning a 400-year period of strife.
timeline.quote: Balduvia declared war on Kjeldor over their ancestral lands, starting a 400-year-long period of strife between the two nations

citation.text: "Balduvia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Facing Lim-Dûl's undead hordes, the traditional enemies ally.
timeline.quote: the two traditional enemy lands allied to battle against his undead hordes

citation.text: "Balduvia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the World Spell and Thaw, Balduvia's lands become farmable; Balduvians and Kjeldorans form New Argive.
timeline.quote: Together they formed the nation of New Argive

citation.text: "Balduvia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An unnamed commander's soldiers and Jötun defend Kjeld against Heidar's hordes over four days.
timeline.quote: The battle lasted four days, and losses increased each day.

citation.text: "Battle of Kjeldor", section "The story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor survives and a bond is forged between Yavimaya and New Argive.
timeline.quote: a bond was forged between Yavimaya and New Argive

citation.text: "Battle of Kjeldor", section "The story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor and Yavimaya destroy the Phyrexians and rout the cultists; a ritual restores the Thaw.
timeline.quote: a Yavimayan ritual permanently ended Rimewind's unnatural winter and restored the Thaw to its proper course

citation.text: "Heidar", section "The end of Heidar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The royal throne and family move to expanding Krov, which becomes the largest city in Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: the royal throne and family moved to the still-expanding Krov

citation.text: "Krov", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Order, a front for Avram Garrison and Lim-Dul, stages a coup to assassinate King Darien; Jodah, Jaya Ballard, Gustha Ebbasdotter and Varchild foil it.
timeline.quote: Their staged coup was foiled by Jodah , Jaya Ballard , Gustha Ebbasdotter , and Varchild defending the king

citation.text: "Order of Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Battle of Kjeldor, King Darien kills Haakon.
timeline.quote: where their leader, Haakon, was killed by King Darien

citation.text: "Order of Stromgald", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garrison forms the Knights of Stromgald to kill the king; Varchild refuses and defends the king with her life.
timeline.quote: Varchild could not go along with murdering the king of the nation

citation.text: "Varchild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Stromgalds are defeated and Lim-Dul is revealed as their benefactor; Varchild becomes first general of the unified army.
timeline.quote: Varchild was honored to become the first general of the nation's unified army in generations

citation.text: "Varchild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the vision Kjeld falls, King Darien dies and Heidar rules Terisiare in perpetual winter.
timeline.quote: leading to the fall of the city of Kjeld and the death of King Darien

citation.text: "Ysidra", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
